name: Dumbbell Incline Scapular Press
steps: Lie back on an incline bench holding two dumbbells straight above your shoulders.
Keep your elbows extended and reach upward by sliding your shoulder blades forward around your ribs.
Let your shoulder blades settle back onto the pad while keeping your arms straight.
tips: Use a short reach without lifting your head.
Keep your elbows extended at the same angle while your shoulder blades glide around your ribs.
